data.text:
JUST IN: Vice Mayor Rhummyla Nicor-Mangilimutan confirmed on Monday, June 30, that 37 families or 100 persons affected by the Kanlaon Volcano left the evacuation center in La Castellana, Negros Occidental without the consent of the local government unit.

Mangilimutan said that barangay officials tried to stop them, but they resisted and even threatened to stage a rally.

Mangilimutan said that those who left the evacuation center were from Barangay Cabagna-an.

She said that the Incident Management Team is currently having a meeting to discuss the matter. | via Glazyl Masculino
